title: Tender: from the call for tenders to the synthesis
description: From the call for tenders found on the portal to the synthesis the account manager uses to decide whether to bid.

variables.code: the code of the call for tenders the round is on, chosen with «Start the round»
variables.specification: the tender document the account manager downloaded from the portal for that call for tenders
variables.search: the account manager's search, with the question it leaves to each lead

steps.title: Technical sheet
Contract sheet
Delivery sheet
Synthesis for the decision
steps.brief: The three sheets on the call for tenders {code} are approved: write the synthesis to decide whether to bid, with the five criteria (1 and 5 from your search {search}, 2, 3 and 4 from the sheets).
